Viola is a carrier board that is compatible with the entire family of the Colibri computer-on-modules.
It comes with the smallest form factor among the Colibri carrier boards. The optimized price v/s feature
trade-off makes it ideal for designing end-products for emerging markets.
For detailed technical information about the suitable computer modules, please refer to the sections
An overview of the Colibri product family:
Viola provides the following features and communication interfaces:
2x USB Host, Type A USB connector.
Unified TFT Interface with built in resistive touch for direct LCD panel connection
Communication Peripherals: SPI, UART, I2C (on extension connector)
Digital I/O Interface: 4 PWM channels and 11 GPIOs (on extension connector)
Analog Input Interface: 4 ADC channels (on extension connector)
USB Client, Micro AB type Connector.
External real-time clock with battery backup

The error won’t affect Ethernet operation, since cable diagnostic (polarity detection) and correction are

Viola features 2X USB 2.0 host interface. The USB interface supports USB 2.0 high speed and
operates at a maximum of 480 Mbit/s, depending upon the Colibri module being used.
Connector type: 2x25 Pin Header Male, 2.54 mm

On Colibri VFxx and iMX6, PIN_55 and PIN_63 supports on-module CAN. CAN1_TX and
CAN1_RX are available on PIN_55 and PIN_63 respectively. This is a module specific feature
and may not be supported by all the computer-on-modules in the Colibri family. For more
details, refer to the datasheet of Colibri computer-on-modules.
The PWM_A signal is also routed to the RGB display connector (X7) to provide backlight
brightness control for the connected LCD displays; for this reason a populated zero ohm
resistor (R15) is placed before connector X9.
The Colibri PXA3XX does not support the PWM_D signal on pin 67; however, it is available on
pin 152 of the SODIMM connector. An option has been provided through a 0 (zero) ohm
resistor (R42), which is, by default, not part of the assembly. This resistor allows you to
connect SODIMM 152 to pin 42 of the Extension Connector.
